title: NBC's STATE OF AFFAIRS: Private Set Tour & Actors on Real-Life Daily Briefs!
description: YH ventures to the set of NBC's political drama "State of Affairs" where we sit down with the talented cast and get a private guided tour from star Tommy Savas! Sit in the POTUS's chair in the Oval Office, play some darts in the Secretary of State's office, and go inside the super-duper top secret Ops Center! Plus, co-stars Adam Kaufman, Cliff Chamberlain, and Sheila Vand are on hand to discuss real-life daily briefings and their secret weapons as actors!
author: Young Hollywood
